content.rendered:
The Scholastic Book Fair is coming to Archer Glen! Book Fair shopping hours are as follows:

Thursday, 5/8, 8:00 am – 8:00 pm (Parents & Students)

Friday, 5/9, 8:00 am – 12:00 pm (Parents & Students)

Monday, 5/12 – Friday, 5/16 – Only students will have the opportunity to shop during their scheduled library time during this week.
